scenarios.name: customer-1
scenarios.why: SELECT INTO +0: '00'; HOUSENAME ' ' comes back as 20 blanks, DATEOFBIRTH as ISO text 1950-07-11

scenarios.name: customer-2-mobile-blank
scenarios.why: every column filled except PHONEMOBILE ' ' (CHAR blanks, not NULL); the host variables are in COMMAREA order, not the SELECT's (PHONEMOBILE before PHONEHOME)

scenarios.name: customer-4-no-email
scenarios.why: PHONEMOBILE and EMAILADDRESS blank, a house name 'Picnic Basket'

scenarios.name: customer-7-no-phones
scenarios.why: both phone numbers blank, a 100-byte email column

scenarios.name: customer-9-sparse
scenarios.why: the sparsest row: phones and email all blank

scenarios.name: customer-10-last
scenarios.why: the highest seeded key; a pre-1940 date of birth

scenarios.name: prefilled-commarea-overwritten
scenarios.why: CA-CUSTOMER-REQUEST arrives full of junk: the nine SELECTed fields are replaced, CA-NUM-POLICIES ('123') and CA-POLICY-DATA are left as they came

scenarios.name: request-id-ignored
scenarios.why: LGICDB01 never tests CA-REQUEST-ID: a request id of spaces still inquires

scenarios.name: customer-not-found
scenarios.why: SQLCODE +100 (no customer 11): CA-RETURN-CODE '01', the customer fields untouched

scenarios.name: customer-zero
scenarios.why: boundary: customer 0, below the seeded keys: +100, '01'

scenarios.name: customer-max-int
scenarios.why: boundary: the largest value S9(9) COMP holds by its PICTURE: +100, '01'

scenarios.name: not-found-keeps-prefill
scenarios.why: +100 with a filled COMMAREA: '01' and every customer byte unchanged

notes: GenApp's Db2 'inquire customer' (LGICDB01, LINKed by LGICUS01 with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA; the COMMAREA is described by the record the caller passes, LGICUS01's DFHCOMMAREA (COPY LGCMAREA), since LGICDB01 includes the same copybook with EXEC SQL INCLUDE: the generated DTO is the caller's): EIBCALEN is checked against 72+18 bytes, CA-CUSTOMER-NUM is moved to an S9(9) COMP host variable, and a SELECT INTO from CUSTOMER (unqualified: the bind's QUALIFIER, GENASA1) fills the nine customer fields of CA-CUSTOMER-REQUEST directly. SQLCODE 0 gives CA-RETURN-CODE '00', +100 (or -913) '01', anything else '90' and WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE. The table is GenApp's own (base/cntl/db2cre.jcl: DDL and its ten customer INSERTs, <DB2DBID> = GENASA1) and is compared after every scenario. Not reachable here: EIBCALEN 0 (ABEND LGCA, l.119-123) and EIBCALEN < 90 ('98', l.140-143) -- the harness passes the whole 32500-byte COMMAREA, with no per-scenario length; SQLCODE -913 (l.197) and any other negative SQLCODE (l.199-202) -- no data in GenApp's seed causes one (every CUSTOMER column is nullable and read without an indicator, but no seeded value is NULL; Db2 errors are not injectable, M2), and the '90' path LINKs to LGSTSQ, GenApp's TS/TD logger, which the harness does not run.
